evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/services/scheduler.rs:168,314,377,497,549,832,858,878,1033,1163,1256,1323,1445,1454 — every metrics access uses self.metrics.lock().unwrap(); if any code panics while holding this Mutex the lock is poisoned and all subsequent locks (including get_metrics() reachable from a metrics/status handler and every counter update in the indefinitely-running background scheduler loop) panic permanently, silently killing scheduled-job processing. Prefer lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) or a poison-tolerant guard.
